output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(a); W=len(a[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=6
    pts=[(r,c,a[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if a[r][c] not in (bg,)]
    # unique-color singleton is the signal
    cnt=Counter(x[2] for x in pts)
    sig=[x for x in pts if cnt[x[2]]==1]
    if not sig: return a
    r,c,col=sig[0]
    others=[x for x in pts if x[2]!=col]
    if not others:
        # isolated signal points toward top
        for j in range(W): a[0][j]=col
        return a
    rs=[x[0] for x in others]; cs=[x[1] for x in others]
    # direction is the exposed edge of the singleton within the little symbol
    if c==min(cs): dr,dc=0,-1
    elif c==max(cs): dr,dc=0,1
    elif r==min(rs): dr,dc=-1,0
    elif r==max(rs): dr,dc=1,0
    else: dr,dc=-1,0
    if dr<0:
        for j in range(W): a[0][j]=col
        rr=r-2
        while rr>0: a[rr][c]=col; rr-=2
    elif dr>0:
        for j in range(W): a[H-1][j]=col
        rr=r+2
        while rr<H-1: a[rr][c]=col; rr+=2
    elif dc<0:
        for i in range(H): a[i][0]=col
        cc=c-2
        while cc>0: a[r][cc]=col; cc-=2
    else:
        for i in range(H): a[i][W-1]=col
        cc=c+2
        while cc<W-1: a[r][cc]=col; cc+=2
    return a"}
